ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 24

3. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 25

4. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 1

5. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 12
   C. 7
   D. 13

6. Solve for x: x + 3 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 12
   C. 3
   D. 13

7. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 20
   C. 9
   D. 21

8. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 121

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

12. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 9

13. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

14. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 33

15. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 12

16. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 1
   C. 56
   D. 57

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. Substitute values: 5² = 5 × 5
